title: Reasoning options reach the chat API
summary:
Chat gained reasoning controls, image caching moved into Enter, and generation shed several tracking paths.

Chat requests gained `reasoning_effort` and `thinking_budget` passthrough, with response schemas that accept provider reasoning fields in regular and streaming responses. The Elevator Challenge moved its requests to Enter's chat API, while the image API spec now documents its existing query options.

Exact-match image caching moved into Enter's image route. Cache hits can return an image without a key; misses still go through authentication, rate limiting, and generation. Earlier cache changes addressed empty entries and chunked responses, though the later worker change also allowed existing zero-byte entries to be served. The GPT Image backend configuration was updated without changing its API.

Image and text generation shed specified analytics and request-logging paths. Several image-user blocking paths were also removed; content-safety checks and image-model hourly limits remain.

highlights.title: Chat reasoning controls
highlights.text: Set `reasoning_effort` or `thinking_budget` in chat requests. Provider reasoning fields can also come through in regular and streaming responses. [Try the chat API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Reusable image cache hits
highlights.text: Exact-match image requests can return a cached result without a key; uncached requests still follow the usual generation path. [Try image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
